tooltip.barium.enable_frustum_culling:
Prevents the game from rebuilding chunks that are not inside the camera's view.
Reduces CPU load when turning around.
tooltip.barium.enable_visibility_graph_c: Uses aggressive ray-casting to only render chunks that are truly visible.
tooltip.barium.enable_advanced_section_c:
Prevents rendering of chunk sections (16x16x16 areas) that are not visible from the camera.
[Warning] Can cause visual bugs. Disabled by default for stability.
tooltip.barium.enable_enclosed_section_c:
Prevents rendering of chunk sections that are completely surrounded by other solid sections.
[Warning] Can cause visual bugs. Disabled by default for stability.
tooltip.barium.cull_empty_sections:
Skips rendering sections of the world that only contain air.
Significant performance boost in worlds with verticality.
tooltip.barium.enable_chunk_update_throt:
Limits how many chunks are sent to the GPU per frame.
Reduces stutters when moving or turning quickly.
tooltip.barium.max_chunk_uploads:
The max number of chunks uploaded to the GPU each frame.
Lower values = smoother, higher values = faster world loading.
tooltip.barium.enable_entity_culling: Stops rendering entities (mobs, items) that are too far away.
tooltip.barium.entity_render_distance: Max distance at which entities are rendered.
tooltip.barium.enable_block_entity_culli: Stops rendering block entities (chests, signs) that are too far away.
tooltip.barium.block_entity_render_dista: Max distance at which block entities are rendered.
tooltip.barium.enable_block_entity_occlu:
Stops rendering block entities that are hidden behind other blocks.
Can significantly improve FPS in bases and villages.
tooltip.barium.block_entity_occlusion_mi: The culling check only activates for entities beyond this distance.
tooltip.barium.enable_dense_foliage_cull: Randomly skips rendering some grass and ferns to make dense areas less demanding.
tooltip.barium.dense_foliage_culling_lev:
How aggressively to cull foliage using a position-based pattern. Higher levels are more aggressive.
0=Off, 1=Light, 2=Medium, 3=Heavy, 4=Extreme.
tooltip.barium.enable_beacon_optimizatio: Stops rendering very distant beacon beams to improve performance.
tooltip.barium.enable_particle_optimizat: Skips rendering particles that are outside the screen or too far away.
tooltip.barium.particle_cull_distance: Particles beyond this distance will not be rendered or ticked.
tooltip.barium.reduce_explosion_particle: Greatly reduces the amount of particles from explosions to prevent lag spikes.
tooltip.barium.enable_global_particle_li: Stops creating new particles if the total number exceeds the limit.
tooltip.barium.max_global_particles: The maximum number of particles allowed at once.
tooltip.barium.cache_debug_hud: Reduces the performance impact of the F3 screen by updating it less frequently.
tooltip.barium.enable_tooltip_caching: Caches item tooltips to reduce lag when hovering over items in inventories.
tooltip.barium.enable_adaptive_fog: Dynamically adjusts fog to maintain a target FPS.
tooltip.barium.adaptive_fog_target_fps: The framerate the adaptive fog will try to maintain.
tooltip.barium.disable_vignette: Removes the dark overlay at the screen edges.
tooltip.barium.disable_entity_outlines: Completely disables the glowing outline effect.
tooltip.barium.enable_half_res_outlines: Renders the glowing effect at half resolution for better performance.
tooltip.barium.enable_entity_tick_cullin: Reduces the update frequency of distant entities' logic (AI).
tooltip.barium.entity_tick_distance: Entities beyond this distance will have their logic updates reduced.
tooltip.barium.reduce_ambient_particles: Reduces the frequency of ambient particle effects (torch smoke, water drips).
tooltip.barium.enable_hopper_culling: Reduces the update frequency of distant hoppers. Huge CPU saver for farms.
tooltip.barium.enable_flood_fill_culling: A robust algorithm that discovers visible chunks by 'flooding' out from the camera. Very stable and effective, prevents rendering anything the player can't see. Recommended ON.
tooltip.barium.enable_occlusion_culling: Stops rendering chunk sections that are 100% surrounded by solid, opaque blocks. Highly effective underground and provides a large FPS boost with no visual bugs.
